card.name: Inside the word intravenous
card.fires_on: The piece 'aven' or 'avenous' right after 'intr' when the word intravenous is split up. It is seen in dosing and administration instructions.

modes.label: intr + avenous
modes.description: The ending 'avenous' completes 'intravenous' after 'intr', often in 'intravenous push' or 'for intravenous use'.
modes.example: Do not administer as an intr<<avenous>> push or bolus.

modes.label: intr + aven + ously
modes.description: The middle piece 'aven' in the adverb 'intravenously' after 'intr'.
modes.example: Administer intr<<aven>>ously at a rate not exceeding 0
